spine: 1. 症狀：研究員回報很長的 prompt 有時拿回其他使用者的內容；155 個受影響回應全部來自超過 681,280 tokens 的 prompt，回覆連貫、用量吻合，client 拿到的卻是 HTTP 200。
2. 前提：KV cache 是固定大小頁面的共用池，頁面在請求之間不歸零，沒被本請求寫過的頁面裝的就是上一個主人的資料。
3. 先看有沒有人利用：排除自家與研究員的測試後，請求的時間與量符合一般長 context 使用，沒有發現蓄意利用的證據；同日 25 分鐘內重現，當天 14:00 下線、19:40 恢復。
4. 第一個原因：1,048,576 tokens 的 context window 對上只放得下 681,280 tokens 的 prefill 池；池大小由啟動時剩餘 GPU 記憶體決定，與 context length 互不強制一致；上線前只驗證 HTTP 回應碼與長 context 效能。
5. 第二個原因：SGLang 把放不下的請求標成 rejected 並換成一個 token 的佔位，但拒絕原因存在 to_finish，finished() 仍回 False，prefill admission 照單全收，decode 預留 8 頁、只有 P0 被寫過，attention 讀到舊頁面。
6. 修復分層：池擴到約 2.04 million tokens 讓拒絕路徑走不到；引擎在 admission 結束被拒絕的請求並讓 decode 核對 token 數（SGLang v0.5.20 至 v0.5.22）；再加上延遲釋放、限制 Mooncake 批次、負載平衡器不再因斷線中止傳輸。
7. 方法論：已知風險不等於已驗證風險；競態與拒絕路徑症狀相同機制不同；文章把長期保證從流程正確換成頁面歸屬標籤在讀取時檢查，並以形式化方法建模，目標寫成盡可能證明。

perspective.mechanism: prefill 池小於 context length，放不下的請求在 SGLang 被標成 rejected 並換成一個 token 的佔位，因 finished() 回 False 而通過 disaggregated 模式的 admission，decode 為它預留的頁面只有 P0 被寫過，其餘仍是舊頁面，attention 讀到後回 HTTP 200。
perspective.tradeoff: 把池擴到約兩倍 context length 要靠調整設定騰出 GPU 記憶體，引擎補丁則是第二道防線；長期做法（頁面歸屬標籤、形式化驗證）文章只說是方向，尚無成品。
perspective.reader_use: 台灣工程師若自架 SGLang 或任何 prefill/decode 分離的推論服務，可以拿池大小對 context length 做部署檢查，並且測錯誤路徑而非只測成功路徑，不依賴 proxy 或引擎來擋放不下的請求。

notes.quote: We have remediated the issue, and we restored the model on September 9.
notes.interpretation: 問題已修復，模型 9 月 9 日恢復。

notes.quote: In total, 155 responses were affected, all to prompts longer than 681,280 tokens.
notes.interpretation: 受影響回應 155 個，全部來自超過 681,280 tokens 的 prompt。

notes.quote: We have confirmed that no other model hosted on Workers AI was affected.
notes.interpretation: Workers AI 上其他模型未受影響。

notes.quote: Gadi Evron submitted a report on September 8 through our HackerOne program stating that very long prompts
notes.interpretation: 研究員 Gadi Evron 9 月 8 日透過 HackerOne 回報。

notes.quote: sometimes returned text that belonged to other users' sessions.
notes.interpretation: 很長的 prompt 有時會拿回屬於其他使用者 session 的文字。

notes.quote: received responses that contained data from other customers' requests made to the same model shortly before theirs.
notes.interpretation: 回應含有同一模型上、稍早其他客戶請求的資料。

notes.quote: It arrived faster than an 8-page prefill should take, and it contained content from other users' KV pages.
notes.interpretation: 在文章的示意流程裡，回應比 8 頁 prefill 該有的時間快，內容來自其他使用者的 KV 頁面。

notes.quote: prompt_tokens matched the long prompt and the reply was coherent.
notes.interpretation: 用量統計吻合長 prompt，回覆連貫。

notes.quote: The client got HTTP 200 instead of HTTP 400.
notes.interpretation: client 拿到 HTTP 200，而不是 HTTP 400。

notes.quote: We found no evidence of deliberate exploitation.
notes.interpretation: 沒有發現蓄意利用的證據；措辭不等於證明沒有人利用。

notes.quote: After excluding our own testing and the researcher's, the requests we identified are consistent in timing and volume
notes.interpretation: 排除自家與研究員的測試後，找出的請求在時間與量上與一般長 context 使用一致；文章未說明 155 個如何被挑出。

notes.quote: the requests we identified are consistent in timing and volume with ordinary long-context use.
notes.interpretation: 請求的時間與量符合一般長 context 使用。

notes.quote: GLM 5.3 launched on Workers AI with a prefill KV pool smaller than its context window.
notes.interpretation: 8 月 27 日上線時 prefill KV 池就小於 context window。

notes.quote: The exposure was present from launch.
notes.interpretation: 暴露從上線就存在。

notes.quote: We deployed GLM 5.3 with a 1,048,576-token context window, but the KV cache pool on our prefill GPUs
notes.interpretation: context window 1,048,576 tokens。

notes.quote: only had room for 681,280 tokens.
notes.interpretation: prefill GPU 的 KV 池只放得下 681,280 tokens。

notes.quote: SGLang sizes it at startup from whatever GPU memory remains after loading the model weights.
notes.interpretation: 池大小由啟動時載入權重後剩餘的 GPU 記憶體決定。

notes.quote: Nothing forces the two to agree, and it is our job to check that they do.
notes.interpretation: 池大小與 context length 互不強制一致，檢查是營運方的責任。

notes.quote: We were aware of this size mismatch; however, during pre-launch testing we observed successful HTTP status codes
notes.interpretation: 他們知道大小不一致，但上線前測試看到的是成功狀態碼。

notes.quote: we only validated HTTP response codes and engine performance at long contexts
notes.interpretation: 上線前只驗證了 HTTP 回應碼與長 context 下的引擎效能。

notes.quote: a streaming body with no error frames
notes.interpretation: 上線前測試的串流 body 沒有 error frame。

notes.quote: Canary prefill node with a larger pool confirmed not susceptible.
notes.interpretation: 14:35 時間線條目：池較大的 canary prefill 節點不受影響；與根因並列，本文讀作受控比較（推論）。

notes.quote: Root cause identified as the prefill pool being smaller than the context length.
notes.interpretation: 9 月 9 日 14:35 找到根因。

notes.quote: Security incident declared. Product Security reproduced the leak using two independent accounts within 25 minutes.
notes.interpretation: 9 月 9 日 13:22 宣告事件，25 分鐘內以兩個獨立帳號重現。

notes.quote: Report received via HackerOne.
notes.interpretation: 時間線：9 月 8 日 23:11 收到報告；9 月 9 日 08:00「Cloudflare begins verifying the HackerOne report.」。

notes.quote: After confirming the scope of the issue, GLM 5.3 was set to private.
notes.interpretation: 時間線：9 月 9 日 14:00 設為 private；同一時間條目「Requests return HTTP 400. Status page updated.」。

notes.quote: All prefill nodes rolled to the corrected configuration.
Full deployment rebuilt with the corrected configuration plus a Cloudflare-authored engine patch
notes.interpretation: 時間線：9 月 9 日 19:04，並以研究員的重現腳本驗證（「Validated against the researcher's reproduction script.」）。

notes.quote: Model restored to public.
a pool of prefill GPUs processes the prompt and produces the model's KV cache for it
notes.interpretation: prefill GPU 處理 prompt 並產生 KV cache。

notes.quote: then hands that cache over remote direct memory access (RDMA)
notes.interpretation: cache 經 RDMA 交給 decode；decode GPU（「a pool of decode GPUs that generate the response.」）生成回應。

notes.quote: The KV cache in GPU memory is a shared pool of fixed-size pages.
notes.interpretation: KV cache 是固定大小頁面的共用池；「Each request is assigned pages when it is admitted and releases them when it finishes.」

notes.quote: Pages are not currently zeroed between requests; the next request that gets a page simply overwrites it.
notes.interpretation: 頁面在請求之間不歸零，沒被寫過的頁面保有前一主人的資料。

notes.quote: A prompt that did not fit the pool was internally marked as rejected and replaced with a one-token placeholder
notes.interpretation: 放不下的 prompt 被標成 rejected 並換成一個 token 的佔位。

notes.quote: The rejection path (Req.set_finish_with_abort) recorded the error to be returned to the client
notes.interpretation: 拒絕路徑函式 Req.set_finish_with_abort 記錄要回給 client 的錯誤；另「swapped the prompt for a one-token placeholder so that the request could drain through the normal batch machinery」。

notes.quote: A rejected request reported itself as live.
notes.interpretation: 被拒絕的請求回報自己還活著。

notes.quote: A rejected request stored its rejection in to_finish, not finished_reason, so finished() still returned False.
notes.interpretation: 拒絕原因存在 to_finish，所以 finished() 仍回傳 False。

notes.quote: The prefill admission queue admitted any request where req.finished() was False.
notes.interpretation: prefill admission queue 接納所有 finished() 為 False 的請求。

notes.quote: In disaggregated mode such as we operate, the admission queues on both prefill and decode checked whether a request was
notes.interpretation: disaggregated 模式下 prefill 與 decode 兩邊都有 admission queue（句子在擷取處截斷）。

notes.quote: The router told the decode node the prompt length (8 pages in the diagram).
notes.interpretation: 示意流程中 router 告訴 decode 節點 prompt 長度為 8 頁。

notes.quote: Decode reserved 8 KV pages for the request.
notes.interpretation: decode 為請求預留 8 個 KV 頁面。

notes.quote: Only page P0 had been written by this request.
notes.interpretation: 只有 P0 被本請求寫過；P0 放佔位是本文的推測。

notes.quote: Pages P1 to P7 still held what earlier requests left in them: other users' prompts and partial generations.
notes.interpretation: P1 至 P7 留著先前請求的內容：其他使用者的 prompt 與部分生成。

notes.quote: Decode started generating and attention read all 8 reserved pages.
notes.interpretation: decode 開始生成，attention 讀了全部 8 個預留頁面。

notes.quote: so the rejection path is never reached for a valid request.
notes.interpretation: 池夠大之後，有效請求不會走到拒絕路徑。

notes.quote: the prefill KV pool now holds about 2.04 million tokens
notes.interpretation: 池現在約放 2.04 million tokens；另「roughly twice the 1,048,576-token context length.」

notes.quote: We adjusted our GLM 5.3 configuration to match our GLM 5.2 configuration, which freed enough GPU memory
notes.interpretation: 把 GLM 5.3 設定調成與 GLM 5.2 一致，騰出 GPU 記憶體。

notes.quote: a request carrying a pending rejection is retired at the disaggregation admission queue, with its original error,
notes.interpretation: 引擎補丁：帶待處理拒絕的請求在 admission queue 以原本錯誤結束。

notes.quote: which also had the decode node verify that the number of tokens transferred matches the number it reserved.
notes.interpretation: decode 核對傳輸的 token 數與預留數一致。

notes.quote: The patch for this issue was released in SGLang v0.5.20, with follow-ups in v0.5.21 and v0.5.22
notes.interpretation: 補丁在 SGLang v0.5.20，後續在 v0.5.21 與 v0.5.22；時間線另列 v0.5.21 在 10 月 2 日、v0.5.22 在 10 月 19 日。

notes.quote: Rejects these requests at admission, before any bootstrap, allocation, or KV transfer.
notes.interpretation: 上游 #38935（v0.5.21）在 admission 就拒絕，不進入 bootstrap、配置、KV 傳輸。

notes.quote: When a request is aborted while prefill is still writing its KV cache to decode over RDMA,
notes.interpretation: 另一類問題：abort 發生在 prefill 仍透過 RDMA 寫 KV 給 decode 時；「the writes already sent cannot be recalled.」「If decode frees those pages right away, those pages can be given to another request,」「and the late writes land in that request's KV cache.」

notes.quote: None of these covered the failure in this incident in which prefill rejected the request, and decode never learned of it.
notes.interpretation: 先前針對競態的修補沒有涵蓋這次事件；另「The bug in this incident was different: a rejected request went through the handoff every time」。

notes.quote: In both cases the result is corrupted output, or one user's data in another user's response, with no error raised.
notes.interpretation: 競態類問題的結果：輸出損壞或他人資料出現在回應中，且不報錯。

notes.quote: Extended deferred release to hold prefill's source pages as well, and to cover every failure type, not just aborts.
notes.interpretation: 延遲釋放擴大到 prefill 來源頁面與所有失敗類型。

notes.quote: so no single transfer call can outlast the release timeout.
notes.interpretation: 已部署有上限的 Mooncake 傳輸批次（「Deployed bounded Mooncake transfer batches」）。

notes.quote: Changed our load balancer so a client disconnect no longer aborts a request mid-transfer.
notes.interpretation: 負載平衡器：client 斷線不再中止傳輸中的請求。

notes.quote: Added a check to every disaggregated deployment change: KV pool size measured against context length
notes.interpretation: 每次 disaggregated 部署變更新增 KV 池對 context length 的檢查。

notes.quote: decode verifies a checksum of the transferred KV before generating.
notes.interpretation: 上游的 per-transfer checksum：decode 生成前核對傳輸 KV。

notes.quote: Fixes for SGLang's KV canary, which detects and logs potential corruption.
notes.interpretation: KV canary 偵測並記錄潛在損壞，文章不再多做定義。

notes.quote: Measure your KV pool and compare it to your context length
notes.interpretation: 給 operator 的第一條建議。

notes.quote: Do not rely on a proxy to enforce the limit, and do not assume the engine will reject what does not fit.
notes.interpretation: 不要靠 proxy 執行限制，也不要假設引擎會拒絕放不下的請求。

notes.quote: This is the engine-side fix, and it is the backstop for the day your check in step one is wrong.
notes.interpretation: 引擎端修補是第一步檢查出錯那天的後盾。

notes.quote: Operators running disaggregated SGLang should update to v0.5.22 or backport these patches as needed.
notes.interpretation: operator 應更新到 v0.5.22 或視情況 backport。

notes.quote: Configure your load balancer to allow requests to proceed up to the first token,
notes.interpretation: 負載平衡器設成讓請求走到第一個 token；另「so that you do not trigger an abort that requires cross-node coordination.」

notes.quote: bound your Mooncake transfer batches so a single timed-out call cannot leave an unbounded tail of writes.
notes.interpretation: 限制 Mooncake 傳輸批次；另「and turns deferred KV release on by default.」描述上游合併後預設開啟延遲釋放。

notes.quote: Every physical KV page carries a tag that changes when the page is reallocated
notes.interpretation: 長期方向之一（Integrity by construction）：頁面標籤；「each request records the tags it expects, and the mapping is checked before decode reads the cache.」「fail that one request rather than return someone else's data.」

notes.quote: We are now directing our experience in formal methods to KV cache transfer engines.
notes.interpretation: 長期方向之二：形式化方法；目標「to model our production SGLang's distributed KV cache system using Mooncake」，並「prove — as far as possible — that a bug like this cannot occur again」。

notes.quote: We are publishing this report as part of a coordinated disclosure.
notes.interpretation: 協調揭露；時間線 10 月 26 日「Coordinated publication with the researcher and RadixArk.」；研究員「with a clear, reproducible script」，SGLang 團隊「who treated this as their problem as well as ours」。

claims.evidence: "A prompt that did not fit the pool was internally marked as rejected and replaced with a one-token placeholder" / "The rejection path (`Req.set_finish_with_abort`) recorded the error to be returned to the client."
claims.note: Quote verbatim modulo code backticks.

claims.claim_text: 被拒絕的請求把拒絕原因存在 to_finish，而不是 finished_reason，於是 finished() 仍然回傳 False。文章接著寫：prefill 的 admission queue 會接納任何 req.finished() 為 False 的請求。…一個被拒絕的請求，回報自己還活著。
claims.location: under H2「放不下的請求，為什麼沒有被擋下來」
claims.evidence: "A rejected request stored its rejection in `to_finish`, not `finished_reason`, so `finished()` still returned False." / "The prefill admission queue admitted any request where `req.finished()` was False." / "A rejected request reported itself as live."

claims.claim_text: router 把 prompt 的長度告訴 decode 節點，圖裡是 8 頁。decode 為這個請求預留了 8 個 KV 頁面。但這個請求實際寫過的只有 P0。P1 到 P7 還留著先前請求留下的東西，…「other users' prompts and partial generations」…decode 開始生成，attention 讀了全部 8 個預留的頁面。
claims.location: under H2「放不下的請求，為什麼沒有被擋下來」
claims.evidence: "The router told the decode node the prompt length (8 pages in the diagram)." "Decode reserved 8 KV pages for the request." "Only page P0 had been written by this request." "Pages P1 to P7 still held what earlier requests left in them: other users' prompts and partial generations." "Decode started generating and attention read all 8 reserved pages."
claims.note: Post notes the 8 pages are the diagram's illustrative number.

claims.claim_text: 合理的推測是 P0 放的就是那個一個 token 的佔位，因為佔位只佔一頁；這是我的推論，不是文章的原話。…prefill 要處理的其實只有一個 token。
claims.location: under H2「放不下的請求，為什麼沒有被擋下來」
claims.note: Explicitly marked as inference in the text. The preceding observation (response faster than an 8-page prefill, content from other users' KV pages) is verified against n07.

claims.claim_text: 頁面在請求之間目前不會歸零，下一個拿到頁面的請求只是把它覆寫。…KV cache 是一個由固定大小的頁面組成的共用池，每個請求在被接納時分到頁面，結束時歸還。
claims.location: under H2「HTTP 200 的回應裡，裝著別人的內容」
claims.evidence: "The KV cache in GPU memory is a shared pool of fixed-size pages." / "Pages are not currently zeroed between requests; the next request that gets a page simply overwrites it."
claims.note: Volatile (current-state statement) but source is 2026-10-26, four days before the post; post preserves 目前.
